bullets_en: A 57-year-old government employee died when an unidentified vehicle hit his scooter from behind on NH-44 at Shamshabad, police said.
The accident happened on Friday morning near Agarwal Estate, Old Madanpally Thanda, as he travelled to his duty in Shadnagar.
Shamshabad police have registered a case and are examining CCTV footage to trace the vehicle and driver.

bullets_en: Hyderabad Traffic Police issued a route plan for Khairatabad Bada Ganesh, with traffic diversions in place from Sept 12 to 24.

headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
title: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
key_facts: 26-year-old woman Hemadurga, Bhimavaram (AP) native, worked at a car company in Banjara Hills
Saturday 12 Sep: stepped out during office break, booked Rapido reportedly to get cellphone repaired
RTC (electric) bus hit the bike taxi in Ameerpet; woman riding pillion came under wheels, died
bike rider seriously injured, hospitalised
bullets_en: A 26-year-old Andhra Pradesh woman was killed on Saturday when an RTC bus hit her Rapido bike in Ameerpet.
The victim, Hemadurga, was a Bhimavaram native working at a car company in Banjara Hills.
She stepped out during an office break, reportedly to get her cellphone repaired.
Riding pillion, she came under the bus wheels; the rider was seriously hurt and hospitalised.
bullets_ur: Andhra Pradesh ki 26-sala khatoon Saturday ko Ameerpet mein RTC bus ki takkar se halak ho gayi.
Hemadurga Bhimavaram ki rehne wali thin aur Banjara Hills ki car company mein kaam karti thin.
Wo office break mein reportedly cellphone theek karwane Rapido bike par ja rahi thin.
Khatoon pillion par thin aur bus ke pahiye tale aa gayin; rider shadeed zakhmi, hospital mein.

headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — TELANGANA
title: 📰 LATEST NEWS — TELANGANA
key_facts: Assembly passed CURE Bill 2026 on Saturday, replacing GHMC Act 1955
property tax hike capped at 10% (draft had 20%) after CM Revanth Reddy's intervention
BJP opposed/demanded withdrawal; AIMIM (Owaisi) sought select committee; CPI supported
Minister Sridhar Babu: apex council advisory-only, mayors/corporators keep powers; 0.15% residential / 0.75% non-residential on capital value; ~Rs 101/yr for 375 sq ft poor household
bullets_en: The Telangana Assembly has passed the CURE Bill 2026, replacing the 70-year-old GHMC Act of 1955.
Property tax hike was capped at 10 per cent, down from the proposed 20, after CM intervention.
BJP opposed the Bill and AIMIM sought a select committee review; the CPI supported it.
Minister Sridhar Babu said the apex council will be advisory-only and mayors keep their powers.
bullets_ur: Telangana Assembly ne CURE Bill 2026 pass kar diya; yeh 70 saal purane GHMC Act 1955 ki jagah lega.
Sarkar ne tax badhotari ko 20 se ghata kar 10 per cent par seemit kiya, CM ke intervention ke baad.
BJP ne Bill ka virodh kiya aur AIMIM ne select committee ko bhejne ki maang ki; CPI ne taid ki.
Minister Sridhar Babu ne kaha apex council sirf advisory hogi, mayors ke powers barkarar rahenge.
